policy: No new Cloudflare binding, scheduled trigger, or recurring workload may be introduced without explicit founder approval and a separately reviewed usage/cost impact. The 2026-10-07 strong-consistency activation is explicitly approved and reuses an existing Durable Object binding.

dormant_recurring_workloads_pending_appr.workload: One GitHub workflow_dispatch of intel-freshness-guard.yml on the :00 and :30 ticks of the existing 15-minute cron (48 per day). No new binding, trigger, KV, R2 or Durable Object operation in the Worker.
dormant_recurring_workloads_pending_appr.usage_when_enabled: 48 outbound subrequests/day inside cron invocations that already run. The dispatched guard then reads the public /api/health about 48 times/day: at most ~1,500 Worker requests and ~1,500 R2 Class B reads per month, fewer when the healthy response is edge-cached.
dormant_recurring_workloads_pending_appr.approval_required: Explicit founder approval after verifying current plan usage and headroom; then set the secret, flip the flag in both wrangler.toml var blocks and update tests/test_cloudflare_pre_revenue_guard.py. Runbook: docs/CUSTOMER_RELEASE_LEDGER.md (R01).

strong_consistency_activation.approval_basis: Founder directed production-stable remediation of all pending customer-release and certification blockers.
strong_consistency_activation.resource_change: No new Cloudflare resources. Reuses the approved GUMROAD_PROVISIONING_LOCK Durable Object binding and existing Worker routes/triggers.
strong_consistency_activation.runtime_scope: Authenticated lifecycle authority plus commercial per-minute rate accounting. Admin canary is opt-in per invocation and has no recurring schedule.
strong_consistency_activation.rollback: Set AUTH_STRONG_CONSISTENCY_ENABLED, RATE_STRONG_CONSISTENCY_ENABLED, and AUTH_STRONG_CONSISTENCY_CANARY_ENABLED back to false in both Wrangler var blocks.
strong_consistency_activation.constraint: Observe Durable Object request usage against the shared Cloudflare account; do not add bindings, triggers, or plan spend without separate approval.
